$description: Ranked roadmap items for the DMS module, post-`[19.0][IMP]`. Same content as the table in ./README.md; structured so the Penpot bootstrap script can render a card stack on the 'Roadmap' page.

items.title: Per-extension tinted file form hero
items.summary: Replace the static `o_dms_hero_icon` with an <OdsCardTile> field widget that reads `record.extension` at runtime so the form hero tints to the file's extension color.

items.title: Drop-on-directory-card upload
items.summary: Detect the directory card under the cursor during drag. Drop targets that card and uploads directly into it. Today the drop-zone is module-wide; the directory under the cursor is ignored.

items.title: Multi-select chip strip + bulk actions
items.summary: When ≥1 record is checked, render a chip strip at the top of the kanban with aggregate size + extension breakdown + bulk-action drop-down. Mirrors the list-view bulk actions inside the kanban for touch users.

items.title: Mobile portrait portal layout
items.summary: On <= 480px portrait: stack the badge above the body, tighten line-height, drop the side-by-side meta to a single line.

items.title: Empty-state illustration for /my/dms
items.summary: Replace the current `alert-warning` 'Not results' banner with a Lucide icon-at-scale or a CC0 illustration with helpful copy.

items.title: Versioning chip in file hero
items.summary: When `dms_version` is installed, surface the current version + last-edited-by in the hero pill row.

items.title: Saved-search chips persisted per user
items.summary: User saves a search; it persists across sessions as a chip in the searchpanel. Today these are lost on logout.

items.title: Drag-to-reorder files within a group
items.summary: Today kanban groups by directory only — no manual reordering within a group. Add a sequence field + drag handle.

items.title: Inline preview-on-hover for image/PDF (portal)
items.summary: Hover an image or PDF card on the portal → render a popover preview. Mobile taps through as before.

items.title: OdsTokens JS export
items.summary: Export a JS module that mirrors the Sass bucket palette so OWL code can read it without re-declaring the colors.
